description: Replace an order-ignoring task scheduler with a real topological sort that also detects cycles
prompts: scheduler.py's order_tasks(deps) ignores the dependency graph entirely and just returns the tasks in whatever order the dict iterates. deps is a mapping of task name -> list of tasks it depends on (which must run before it). Implement a real topological sort: every task must appear in the output AFTER all of its dependencies, every task named anywhere (as a key OR only as a dependency value) must appear exactly once in the output, and a cycle (e.g. A depends on B which depends on A) must raise ValueError instead of silently returning a partial or wrong order.
name: add_python_topological_sort_task_deps
